## February was stronger (higher revenue, higher EBITDA, better margin)

Based on the line items in the monthly P&Ls, **February outperformed January** because it delivered **+$130k more revenue** with only **+$11.5k more OpEx**, resulting in **+$118.5k higher EBITDA** and a **+2.6 pp higher EBITDA margin**. - **M&A Advisory Fees:** **$1.28M (Feb) vs $1.15M (Jan) = +$130k** [1][2]
- **Strategic Consulting:** **$310k vs $285k = +$25k** [1][2]

- **Restructuring Advisory:** **$680k vs $720k = –$40k** [1][2]

**Net:** +130k (the M&A lift was the single biggest driver). [1][2]

### 2) Expense drivers (+$11.5k total OpEx)
Most “fixed” cost lines were essentially flat (e.g., **Salaries & Wages were $985k in both months**; **Office Lease $137.5k in both**). [1][2] The month-over-month increase came mainly from:
